answer: The strongest single control I know for this is cross-chain identity proof via OpenOcean, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here: 454 aliases need 454 independent proofs, and one failed proof burns the whole cluster's bond. The timber of the design is public, the glacier of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the horizon of honest work is what finally pays. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
